$comment: Where the football schedule's name (cfb-teams.json `n`) is not the one fans use. Kept tiny on purpose (Miami (FL) is here so the two Miamis always carry their state; the schedule says just "Miami"; Southeastern Louisiana is the school's own name, where the schedule abbreviates it "SE Louisiana"): the schedule name already is the sports-facing one for almost every school (Iowa State, Ole Miss, NC State, Miami (OH), Southern Miss, UAlbany). Read by src/lib/cfbTeams.ts (cfbName) and by scripts/cfb-production-check.mjs, so the app and its production check share one answer.
